breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the flexure formula with a linear stress distribution, computing maximum stress at the extreme fiber (y = h/2 = 50 mm) and implicitly recognizing zero stress at the neutral axis. There is no mention of uniform stress distribution through the depth, which was the erroneous instruction in the incomplete prompt.
